{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Environmental Protection Agency has rewritten laws to advance the Democrats' climate change agenda.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Department of Health and Human Services has ignored the enacted text of the Affordable Care Act to do whatever it wants in healthcare.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Department of Labor and National Labor Relations Board have scrapped decades of labor law to implement the agenda of big labor.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Dodd-Frank law is crushing small and community banks and other lenders.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Federal Communications Commission is imperiling the freedom of the internet.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for reinstating the Glass-Steagall Act of 1933 which prohibits commercial banks from engaging in high-risk investment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Sensible regulations can be compatible with a vibrant economy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Regulations can prevent the strong from exploiting the weak.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Currently, regulators are exploiting everyone.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to make regulations minimally intrusive, confined to their legal mandate, and respectful toward the creation of new and small businesses.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to revisit existing laws that delegate too much authority to regulatory agencies and review all current regulations for possible reform or repeal.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Endorsement of Republican legislation, already passed by the House, to require approval by both houses of Congress for any rule or regulation that would impose significant costs on the American people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Recommendation that Congress work towards legislation that requires removal of a regulation of equal or greater economic burden when a new regulation is enacted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
